layer_note: paper layers are 0-23 and each probes a block's output, so the paper's layer L = our point L+1 (point 0 = embedding, point k = output of block k, point 25 = post-LN). paper_layer = point 9 (the paper's layer 8); paper_layer_alt = point 8.
dims_note: dims = 2K for 2-output probes (direction's sin, cos), K for 1-output probes; paper Fig. 22's y-axis counts probes (K)
K_loose_note: K_loose_censored = true: the sequence stopped (MAE rule or cap) while R2 was still above the loose threshold, so K_loose is a floor, not a count
K_source: pooled: first at-chance round of the fold-mean curve, minus 1
alpha_folds_source: CV over each fold's training rows
alpha_note: all-train α: paper protocol and saved basis
standardiser_note: step-1 all-train standardiser (includes held-out folds' activations; label-free)

paper.dims_note: dims = 2K for 2-output probes (direction's sin, cos), K for 1-output probes; paper Fig. 22's y-axis counts probes (K)
paper.K_loose_note: K_loose_censored = true: the sequence stopped (MAE rule or cap) while R2 was still above the loose threshold, so K_loose is a floor, not a count
paper.test_read: paper protocol: the test split is scored at every round of the all-train probe sequence; this is step 2's one read of test (spec §3). The nested K and the saved basis length do not use test.

basis: first 82 probes of the all-train sequence (length = nested pooled K)

seeds.other: all other RNG seeds are 0 (bootstrap, folds, null draws, shuffles); random-removal controls use seeds 0..n-1

provenance.test_read: paper protocol: the test split is scored at every round of the all-train probe sequence; this is step 2's one read of test (spec §3). The nested K and the saved basis length do not use test.
